CustomField.description: Set on the paid request raised by converting Unpaid leave days back to Annual leave. Split From points at the Unpaid request the days came out of. Without this marker a converted record is indistinguishable from the unpaid continuation of a split, which is the opposite kind of record.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Ticked when this request was raised by converting unpaid days to Annual leave. Set automatically.
CustomField.label: Converted From Unpaid
